description:

The capital of Russia and the most Soviet city in existence, Moscow, is a pretty cool place and exciting place to travel to. However, many can get surprised at the fact that not every Russian likes Moscow and that some of them haven't even ever visited it. I've been to Moscow plenty of times now, so I took my Russian friend Arina to Moscow for the first time, and in this video we'll see her raw and real reaction to visiting Moscow, as well as seeing the Red Square, the Kremlin, the Lenin Mausoleum and St Basil's Cathedral for the first time!
